headline: Get paid by the people who love your work.
lede: Publish a photo, a video, an audio track, or a document. Set your price. You keep 99%.
moneyIntro: Three things creators want to know. Kaskama answers all three.

moneyPoints.detail: Kaskama takes 1%. That is the whole fee.

moneyPoints.claim: You get paid on the spot.
moneyPoints.detail: The moment a fan pays, the money is yours. No request, no minimum, no hold.

moneyPoints.claim: No one can hold your money.
moneyPoints.detail: The money goes straight from your fans to you.

fanViewIntro: An example creator. Your fans subscribe for 30 days, or unlock one post at a time.
